_comment: Enforced by .claude/hooks/chunk-scope-guard.js before every Edit/Write. See ai-system/live-work-protocol.md section 8. Absent file = no enforcement (opt-in by design).
_files: Paths the chunk may edit. Supports exact paths, 'dir/' prefixes, and * wildcards. live-work/ is included because CLAUDE.md rules 6 and 7 REQUIRE the Builder to write run logs, checkpoint requests and the session handoff there — a scope that omits it makes the Builder's own protocol obligations impossible to meet, which is the B-1 finding in architect-plan-response.md.
_protected: Approved-foundation and canonical-governance paths the Builder must not touch. Denied unless the same path also appears in 'unlocked'. Narrowed to the specific canonical files rather than a blanket 'project-intelligence/**', which would have swept up live-work scratch with them.
_unlocked: Protected paths Carl has explicitly authorised for THIS chunk. Overrides 'protected'. Carl's call, not the Builder's.
